content.title: Volunteer
content.summary: The Nature Center seeks volunteers aged 13 and older to assist with various roles, including garden assistance, nature education, and community outreach. Interested individuals must submit an application, undergo a background check, and commit to three hours of service each month. Volunteers benefit from training opportunities, community engagement, and recognition events for their contributions.
content.body:
![Woman wearing volunteer shirt and hat, holding branches and speaking to a group of young children.](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=5430)

Explore. Discover. Learn. Grow. Serve.

Staff and volunteers work toward our mission by teaching public programs, leading interactive activities, attending outreach events, working in our demonstration garden and more. The Nature Center encourages volunteers to share their passions and connect families with nature. As everyone has their own special knowledge or skill, all volunteers are welcome.

**Volunteers must be ages 13 or older. Younger persons may accompany an adult volunteer and must be supervised at all times. Other limitations may apply.**

## Who Do We Need?

Available volunteer positions include:

- Garden Assistant
- Nature Educator
- Nature Center Host
- MVNC Rentals Host
- Outreach and Event Ambassador
- Community Science
- Park Patrol
- Animal Caretakers
- Camp Docent
- Additional Opportunities

## Volunteering Requirements

Before you can become a volunteer, see if you are able to meet the requirements:

- Submit a volunteer application
- Complete a background check with the City of Arvada
- Complete an interview with Nature Center staff (not required for all positions)
- Attend a New Volunteer training (offered biannually) and any additional trainings (required for some positions)
- Provide an email address and phone number

Please contact us if accommodations are needed for school requirements or other needs (internships, senior projects, etc.).

## Volunteer Commitment

By being an active volunteer, you pledge to commit to:

- Three (3) hours of volunteer time each month
- Use the Sign-Up Genius to sign up for volunteer slots
- Communicate with staff

## Volunteer Benefits

Volunteering at the Nature Center is a great way to meet new people, get involved in the community, learn new skills, and make a difference! To show our appreciation for all that volunteers contribute, we also provide:

- Enrichment opportunities, such as field trips to other interpretive sites, social outings, and more
- Workshops and development opportunities to share ideas and connect
- Volunteer Appreciation Event for volunteers with at least 15 hours of service throughout a given year
- Staff pricing or free programs and facility rental discounts at the Nature center
- Year-end service awards to recognize outstanding participation and contributions

## Application Documents And Submission Form

Applications will be reviewed and processed on a biannual basis. All volunteers are required to complete a criminal background check, some volunteer positions may require a short interview with staff. Onboarding and orientations are offered biannually (March & September). **Please know that when you apply as a volunteer we will reach out to you when it is closer to the onboarding time, so you may not hear back from us until April or August right before those training dates.**

- [Volunteer Enrollment Form](https://arvada-forms-mvnc.app.transform.civicplus.com/forms/49498)
- [Volunteer Waiver Agreement-City of Arvada](https://arvada-forms-mvnc.app.transform.civicplus.com/forms/49551)
